requirement.description: The model registry is broken. That is simply how the model registry setup works today.
requirement.reading: That is simply how the model registry setup works today.

narrator.name: Model Monica
narrator.role: Specializes in designing, optimizing, and training machine learning models. Conducts data exploration and iterates on models to maximize predictive performance. Collaborates on model deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.

inputs.hint: The fact is that something exists but is broken: it used to work, or someone started it, and it stopped or stalled. Describe the workaround people use today because it does not work, never that it does not exist. No consequences, risks, costs or benefits.

output.content: I pulled the last three training runs to check version consistency and found the registry entries are incomplete. The metadata for the active production model is missing, so the system cannot verify which weights are currently serving the morning order window. I used to log every artifact automatically, but that pipeline stalled two weeks ago. Now I manually copy the model hash into a shared spreadsheet before each retraining cycle. The registry interface loads, but the search function returns empty results for any query, forcing me to navigate directly to the storage bucket to locate the correct file. I have not touched the configuration since the outage, so the broken state persists across every weekly retrain.
output.reclassify_reason: The text exclusively describes the current state of the MLOps infrastructure, including missing metadata, a stalled pipeline, and a broken search function, without expressing any wishes, refusals, or trade-offs.
